# WRLD.design

> The open design system behind every WRLD surface: tokens, type, components, brand rules and reference implementations for WRLD Tech Co. and its properties (wrld.tech, WRLD.host, WRLD.AI, WRLD.Services, WRLD.Support, WRLD.Press, WRLD.One). Served from the Cloudflare edge; source of truth is github.com/WRLDInc/DesignSystem.

Everything here is public, read-only and CORS-open. No credentials are needed to read it. Content signals in /robots.txt allow search, ai-input and ai-train. Machine-readable discovery lives at /.well-known/api-catalog, and the OpenAPI description of the served files is /openapi.json.

Non-negotiables when you build with it: surfaces stay monochrome and accents are interactive only; sentence case everywhere; no emoji as iconography (Lucide, 1.5px stroke); the starburst mark is never a circle or disc; `wrld.tech` and `wrld.design` are lowercase, `WRLD.AI`, `WRLD.host`, `WRLD.Services`, `WRLD.Support`, `WRLD.Press`, `WRLD.One` keep their casing.

## Start here

- [README — the brand book and index](https://wrld.design/README.md): entity map, voice, visual foundations, iconography, what lives where.
- [SKILL.md — the agent skill](https://wrld.design/SKILL.md): how an AI agent should use this system to produce on-brand work.
- [Master brand brief](https://wrld.design/brand/CLAUDE.md): the authoritative brief for any assisted design or content work.
- [Interactive system page](https://wrld.design/system): foundations, components and brand, with copyable prompts.

## Tokens and stylesheets

- [styles.css](https://wrld.design/styles.css): the one-line consumer entry point (tokens + type + fonts).
- [tokens/tokens.css](https://wrld.design/tokens/tokens.css): the canonical CSS custom properties, light and dark.
- [tokens/tokens.json](https://wrld.design/tokens/tokens.json): the same tokens as data.
- [tokens/tokens.ts](https://wrld.design/tokens/tokens.ts): typed export for TypeScript consumers.
- [registry/theme/wrld.css](https://wrld.design/registry/theme/wrld.css): the generated shadcn / Tailwind v4 theme.

## Components

- [registry/manifest.json](https://wrld.design/registry/manifest.json): every 21st.dev component with slug, description and tags.
- [_ds_manifest.json](https://wrld.design/_ds_manifest.json): the UI-kit bundle manifest and the preview-card index.
- [ui_kits/wrld-tech/](https://wrld.design/ui_kits/wrld-tech/): flagship marketing kit.
- [ui_kits/wrld-ai/](https://wrld.design/ui_kits/wrld-ai/): product dashboard kit.
- [Login design guidelines](https://wrld.design/docs/LOGIN_DESIGN.md): how a WRLD sign-in surface is built, and which identity provider fronts which door.

## Identity and agent access

- [auth.md](https://wrld.design/auth.md): agent audience, registration methods and credential use for WRLD identity.
- [OAuth protected resource metadata](https://wrld.design/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource): the authorization servers WRLD surfaces trust.
- [Agent skills index](https://wrld.design/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json): discoverable skills with digests.
